license.api_body: The API needs a license key on this ChatVia.ai install. Keys you made earlier are kept, and they work again once the install has a license.
license.teams_body: More teams need a license key on this ChatVia.ai install. Your first team and its roles keep working, and teams you made earlier stay as they are.
license.agents_of_limit: {count} of {limit} agents without a license key
license.agents_body: Without a license key, a workspace can have {limit} agents. Delete an agent, or add a license key to this ChatVia.ai install.
license.voice_hint: Needs a license key on this ChatVia.ai install.
license.capabilities_body: Capabilities need a license key on this ChatVia.ai install. Without one, agents do not use them in chats. Your settings are kept, and they work again once the install has a license.
license.forms_body: Forms and leads need a license key on this ChatVia.ai install. Your forms and the leads you collected are kept, and they come back once the install has a license.
